plaatsen.tekst: For we have ➔ not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make ➔ thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
